mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a component of speakers meaning that constitutes aspects of what is meant without necessarily being part of what is said."
Implicature is a component of speakers meaning that constitutes aspects of what is meant without necessarily being part of what is said.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the logical meaning of a sentence or meanings logically associated with or entailed by a sentence."
Presupposition refers to the logical meaning of a sentence or meanings logically associated with or entailed by a sentence.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act that innately damages the face of the addressee or the speaker by acting in opposition to the wants and desires of the other through verbal or non-verbal forms of communication."

Face Threatening Acts A face threatening act is an act that innately damages the face of the addressee or the speaker by acting in opposition to the wants and desires of the other through verbal or non-verbal forms of communication.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the description of the meaning of words through structural sets of semantic features, which are given as ―present‖ or ―absent‖ or indifferent with reference to feature."

Componential analysis refers to the description of the meaning of words through structural sets of semantic features, which are given as ―present‖ or ―absent‖ or indifferent with reference to feature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the public self-image that every adult tries to project."
Face is the public self-image that every adult tries to project.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the perlocutionary act, a consequence of the child's interpretation of the mother's act of stating."
The child's cry is the perlocutionary act, a consequence of the child's interpretation of the mother's act of stating.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relation in which the truth of one sentence necessarily implies the truth of another."
Entailment is a relation in which the truth of one sentence necessarily implies the truth of another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the relation of inclusion of meaning for instance, the fact that the meaning of the word ‗rat' is included in the meaning of rodent."
Hyponymy refers to the relation of inclusion of meaning for instance, the fact that the meaning of the word ‗rat' is included in the meaning of rodent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of saying, producing meaningful sounds, words with certain reference."
A locutionary act is the act of saying, producing meaningful sounds, words with certain reference.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the things that are communicated even though they are not explicitly expressed."
implicatures refer to the things that are communicated even though they are not explicitly expressed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the theory that accounts for the redressing of the affronts to face posed by face-threatening acts to addressees."
Politeness theory is the theory that accounts for the redressing of the affronts to face posed by face-threatening acts to addressees.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that everyone can afford to eat well."
Cheap food means that everyone can afford to eat well.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to to represent the predicate while subject argument can be represented by a lower case letter usually chosen from a to t - called an individual constant."
A capital predicate letter is used to to represent the predicate while subject argument can be represented by a lower case letter usually chosen from a to t - called an individual constant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to add to the common ground that additional content that the dean's daughters are charming."
Toyin's assertion is an attempt to add to the common ground that additional content that the dean's daughters are charming.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to speak or behave in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people's needs and feelings."
Politeness is the ability to speak or behave in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people's needs and feelings.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to point to a situation outside a text (situational deixis) or to the speaker's and hearer's (shared) knowledge of the world (knowledge deixis)."
Primary deixis is used to point to a situation outside a text (situational deixis) or to the speaker's and hearer's (shared) knowledge of the world (knowledge deixis).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a message that is not found in the plain sense of the sentence."
The conversational implicature is a message that is not found in the plain sense of the sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a correspondence with facts or covert descriptions of state of affairs in the world."
Truth means a correspondence with facts or covert descriptions of state of affairs in the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as a kind of context."
The talk itself is regarded as a kind of context.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series of maxims, which Leech has proposed as a way of explaining how politeness operates in conversational exchanges."
The Politeness Principle The politeness principle is a series of maxims, which Leech has proposed as a way of explaining how politeness operates in conversational exchanges.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means any word which says how many or how much of something is being referred to."
A quantifier means any word which says how many or how much of something is being referred to.

speech act

horizontal line

proposition

performative

generalization
